values.Title: How Do Astronauts Unwind in Space?

values.Definition: góc nhìn, vị trí quan sát
values.ExampleSentence: There, they can refine their photography skills and reconnect with home as they peer at it from a unique vantage point.

values.Speaker: Narrator
values.Text: But exercising also helps maintain mental relaxation and well-being. And sometimes it's really just fun.

values.Speaker: Narrator
values.Text: What's important is preserving their mental health and finding outlets to relax and de-stress.

values.Text: Fitness is another staple. Crews workout for about two hours each day to maintain bone and muscle density and heart health.

values.Text: Some astronauts bring their musical talents to orbit, serenading colleagues and seeking harmony some 250 miles above Earth.
values.VietnameseMeaning: Một số phi hành gia mang tài năng âm nhạc lên quỹ đạo, chơi nhạc cho đồng nghiệp nghe và tìm sự hòa điệu cách Trái Đất khoảng 250 dặm.

values.QuestionText: Which sport did crews try in microgravity?
values.Explanation: "In microgravity, crews have tossed around a rugby ball, attempted ping pong, and even channeled their inner Olympians." — 01:00

values.Text: But when we go to the Moon and Mars, astronauts will face longer periods of time in deep space and be confined to smaller spacecraft,

values.Speaker: Narrator
values.Text: making mental health care an even greater priority.

values.Text: Just like on Earth, sports can foster a sense of community and break up the workday.
